subject: Post-discovery — half-hour walkthrough & stakeholder readiness
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@novaflow.ai>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery — half-hour walkthrough & stakeholder readiness

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — great to hear more about NovaFlow's data routing constraints and the latency targets for your search assistant. Quick recap and proposed next step:

- Recap: primary use case is low-latency query augmentation for internal docs (sub-second target for 95th pct under typical traffic); need encryption-in-transit & audit logs for compliance.
- Next step: propose a concise half-hour product walkthrough to show the runtime behavior (KV cache, batching) and discuss a lightweight proof-of-concept path.

Availability from our side (all in PDT):
- Tue Aug 3 — 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed Aug 4 — 11:30–12:00

Marcus (SE) will lead the deep-dive; Lauren will join for contracting/next-step alignment. Agenda (20–30 min): 1) quick recap of goals, 2) live walk of inference behavior and perf expectations, 3) recommended pilot approach + success criteria.

Attachments: MAP_NovaFlow_v1.pdf (mutual action plan draft), discovery-notes-20270801.txt (short notes from call).

Please confirm which slot works best or share 2–3 windows that fit your calendar. If there are additional stakeholders who should be on the call (security, infra), flag them and we’ll widen the invite.

Best,
Grace
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: MAP_NovaFlow_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: discovery-notes-20270801.txt (text/plain)]

From: Samir Desai <samir@novaflow.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@novaflow.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery — half-hour walkthrough & stakeholder readiness

Grace — thanks for the recap and the MAP. That aligns with our expectations. Two quick items about scheduling: we operate on IST for the product team in India (Priya), while my team is PDT — would prefer a late-morning PDT / evening IST overlap.

Two candidate slots that work here:
- Wed Aug 4 — 08:30 PDT / 21:00 IST
- Thu Aug 5 — 09:30 PDT / 22:00 IST

Priya is available for either of those but asked whether the agenda could reserve ~5 minutes at the end to confirm data handling and SOC-2 artifact requirements.

Also looping in Asha (security) — she may join the walkthrough or do a short follow-up (asha@novaflow.ai).

On attachments: reviewed MAP at a glance, will share an internal comment thread after Priya signs off.

Thanks,
Samir
Product Lead, NovaFlow

Samir — perfect, thanks for the timezone note. Wed Aug 4 at 08:30 PDT / 21:00 IST works for us. I’ll put Marcus down as the lead.

Proposed updated agenda (20–25 min):
- 0:00–5:00 — goals alignment / success criteria (Grace + Samir)
- 5:00–18:00 — live run: batching/prefix cache behavior, perf expectations (Marcus)
- 18:00–25:00 — pilot path & next steps (Grace + Lauren)
- 25:00–30:00 — security artifacts Q&A (Asha / Priya)

Prep asks:
- Marcus: bring a short slide with perf expectations for 1k qps+ and char limits; demo a small cached prefix scenario.
- Priya/Asha: if possible, flag any specific compliance docs you’ll want pointers to (SOC 2, encryption keys).

I’ll send a calendar invite with a short meeting doc and the MAP attached.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Grace
